'''Trade''' is a tier three [[technology]] that unlocks the [[Market]], a [[building]] that produces two [[stars]] per turn for each adjacent resource building, and the Wealth task, which awards the [[Emperor's Tomb]] when 100 stars are accumulated.

For [[Polaris]], Trade unlocks the [[Ice Bank]], a building that produces two stars per turn for every 20 frozen tiles in the world, and the Wealth task.

For [[Cymanti]], Trade unlocks the [[Clathrus]], a building that produces one star per turn for each adjacent [[Algae]], and the Wealth task.
